title: Abaye bar Nazi, father-in-law of Ravina
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman mentions him in [Bava Kamma 115a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.115a.22-24) according to [the Rif’s reading](https://www.sefaria.org/Rif_Bava_Kamma.42a.6); see [the entry Avimi bar Nazi](https://www.girsology.com/toledot?entry=h-138c16e3ab9ed5e2&lang=en).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Rif witness names Abaye bar Nazi, with a gloss recording Avimi as the reading of the Gemara. Its family expression is “Rabbi’s father-in-law,” whereas Hyman reports “Ravina’s father-in-law.”

The linked Gemara reads Avimi bar Nazi, Ravina’s father-in-law. [Heilprin’s Avimi entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=153&lang=en) records the Rif’s Abaye form and leaves it for further examination.
